plugin_desc: Geist and Vertiv PDU and environmental SNMP child template for devices under Geist PEN 21239. Interface traffic is supplied by the shared NetworkService SNMP IF-MIB floor rather than a plugin-side ifHC expansion. Proven VERTIV-V5 private increments under 1.3.6.1.4.1.21239.5 are pduTotalRealPower as pdu_active_power_watts, pduPhaseCurrent and optional pduLineCurrent plus pduOutletMeterCurrent as ampere readings scaled by /100, tempSensorTemp as env_temperature_celsius scaled by /10 with temperatureUnits (0=Fahrenheit, 1=Celsius), and humiditySensorValue as env_humidity_percent. CPU, memory, fan and PSU scalars are not invented. Airflow, RPM and relay trees are not collected in this pass. Supported brands/models - Geist and Vertiv IMD/PDU devices that expose the VERTIV-V5 tree and standard IF-MIB.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: pdu_active_power_watts
metrics.description: PDU total real power in watts from VERTIV-V5 pduTotalRealPower (1.3.6.1.4.1.21239.5.2.3.1.1.9). Empty PDU tables yield no rows. Persistently high values may indicate overload on the PDU feed.

metrics.name: pdu_phase_current_amps
metrics.description: PDU phase current in amperes from VERTIV-V5 pduPhaseCurrent (1.3.6.1.4.1.21239.5.2.3.2.1.8). The SNMP value is hundredths of an amp RMS and is scaled by /100 in the query. Empty phase tables yield no rows.

metrics.name: pdu_line_current_amps
metrics.description: Optional PDU line current in amperes from VERTIV-V5 pduLineCurrent (1.3.6.1.4.1.21239.5.2.3.4.1.4). The SNMP value is hundredths of an amp RMS and is scaled by /100 in the query. Empty line tables yield no rows.

metrics.name: pdu_outlet_current_amps
metrics.description: PDU outlet current in amperes from VERTIV-V5 pduOutletMeterCurrent (1.3.6.1.4.1.21239.5.2.3.6.1.8). The SNMP value is hundredths of an amp RMS and is scaled by /100 in the query. Empty outlet-meter tables yield no rows.

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.query: ((env_temperature_celsius{instance_type='network_service', __$labels__} / 10) and on(instance_id) group_left() (snmp_temperature_units{instance_type='network_service'} == 1)) or (((env_temperature_celsius{instance_type='network_service', __$labels__} / 10 - 32) * 5 / 9) and on(instance_id) group_left() (snmp_temperature_units{instance_type='network_service'} == 0)) or (env_temperature_celsius{instance_type='network_service', __$labels__} / 10)
metrics.description: Per-sensor environment temperature in degrees Celsius from VERTIV-V5 tempSensorTemp (1.3.6.1.4.1.21239.5.2.4.1.5). The SNMP value is tenths of a degree and is scaled by /10. When temperatureUnits is present, 1 is Celsius and 0 is converted from Fahrenheit. Empty temperature tables yield no rows. Persistently high values may indicate cooling or ambient-temperature risk.

metrics.name: env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Per-sensor relative humidity in percent from VERTIV-V5 humiditySensorValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.21239.5.2.12.1.5). The SNMP value is already 0-100 percent. Empty humidity tables yield no rows.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
